diagnostic_config.scope: Observational development-policy diagnostic; no training, causal early-failure claim, or held-out evidence.
reconstruction_choices: The controller must explicitly supply both the completed checkpoint and the full development JSON/JSONL through lab --input. Select exactly one reference evaluation with the checkpoint's completed episode count; never search runs, choose a nearby episode, or deserialize outside the standalone lab entry point.

Resolve the original training, environment, action, observation, aircraft-type and PPO configurations from source, and apply the original strict checkpoint validator and source/software version identity checks. Diagnostic settings are separate and do not relax resume compatibility.

Replay all 12 original development cases with the original sampled-policy seeds and select_actions. A passive model forward hook copies its already-computed masked logits and mask. Compute diagnostic probabilities in float64 without another policy forward or random draw; do not replace the original sampling calculation.

Conditional entropy is computed over the legal joint actions at this decision. Divide by log(valid_count), returning JSON null and literal CSV null for one legal action. Entropy of the pooled probability mixture and empirical selected-action entropy are different statistics, reported separately.

Component indices and probability marginals use C-order (4,5,3), with nominal action 37. Repeated locked targets remain decisions, so marginal frequencies describe the visited state and mask distribution rather than an unmasked preference or time occupancy.

Record reward components returned by the original env.step, actual entry/terminal ages, true pre-decision state, selected and accepted targets, locks and per-flight outcomes. Group by type, terminal status, type/status, and pre-decision lock state. These observations cannot establish that a policy intentionally exploits early termination.

The original reference NR summaries are reused and explicitly labeled; no NR simulation is performed. Replay sample summaries and action histograms must match reference exactly, excluding only wall_seconds and process_peak_rss_mib.

No optimizer, backward pass, checkpoint save, PPO collector or training update. Preserve model tensor identity, disable gradients, count real forwards and sampled aircraft decisions, and retain the private per-case sampling generator's state digests.

One streaming CSV has a 60000-row and 96 MiB limit, leaving space for JSON under a 128 MiB lab output budget. All files are under LAB_RUN_DIR; native scratch belongs to /tmp. Exceptions or failed comparisons return nonzero and preserve partial artifacts. Hooks are removed in finally.
